# @hipdev/rebask-cloudflare

> Community MIT Cloudflare Workers adapter for native Rebask build-time PPR.
> Experimental. Exact compatibility: @rebask/core0.2.0, Vite8.3.5, Node24+.

- [Quick start](https://github.com/hipdev/rebask-cloudflare/blob/main/README.md)
- [Spanish guide](https://github.com/hipdev/rebask-cloudflare/blob/main/README.es.md)
- [Agent instructions](https://github.com/hipdev/rebask-cloudflare/blob/main/AGENTS.md)
- [Architecture and limits](https://github.com/hipdev/rebask-cloudflare/blob/main/docs/architecture.md)
- [Testing](https://github.com/hipdev/rebask-cloudflare/blob/main/docs/testing.md)
- [Source](https://github.com/hipdev/rebask-cloudflare/tree/main/src)

Configure cloudflarePpr() after native Rebask plugins and createCacheHandler() in
rebask.config.ts. Build once; deploy .output/server/wrangler.json. Never publish
private snapshots as assets. Supports immutable build-time PPR, not durable ISR.
